_meta.description: The fallback index template for the processed-evidence streams: the built-in logs-*-* composition (logsdb, ECS dynamic mappings, the operator's logs@custom extension point) plus logs-dxdfir@settings (the router default_pipeline and the stack-wide backstops). It carries NO lane model — each lane now has its own higher-priority template (logs-dxdfir-<lane>, priority 500, matching logs-dxdfir.<lane>-*) that adds only that lane's fields, so a lane's columns never merge into another lane's stream. This one (priority 200) catches the streams without a dedicated template: anamnesis (ECS + backstops is enough) and any brand-new processed/<type>/ evidence, which ships untouched into logs-dxdfir.<type>-*. The failure store (rejected evidence rows) is kept a year instead of the cluster default's 30 days — a rejected row is evidence waiting for a mapping fix and a re-ingest.
